description: This PHP source file defines the ByIdFilter class which implements the ByIdFilterInterpreter interface. It is responsible for interpreting filter structures to produce SQL 'IN' clause filters for identifying records by their IDs within the context of a JSON API filter interpreter for SuiteCRM.

classes.name: ByIdFilter
classes.description: Implements the ByIdFilterInterpreter interface for interpreting 'by ID' filters in the SuiteCRM JSON API framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ByIdFilter with a container interface to access dependencies like the database manager.

methods.name: getByIdFilter
methods.description: Accepts a filter structure array, validates its contents, and constructs an SQL 'IN' clause filter string for the specified IDs.
